best_for: Developers, students and architects who need to draw UML and related diagrams on their own computer and would rather pay once than subscribe.
description:
StarUML is a software modeling tool made by MKLabs Co., Ltd. It covers most UML 2 diagrams, from class, use case and sequence diagrams to activity, state and deployment diagrams, and lets you mix them with entity-relationship, data flow, flowchart, mind map and C4 diagrams in one project.

You can generate source code from a model or read existing code back into one, turn Mermaid text into diagrams, and export diagrams to PDF or publish them as HTML pages. Models are saved as plain JSON files, so scripts can read them, and you can extend the app with JavaScript or let AI tools work with your models through its MCP server. Light and dark themes are built in.

points.title: 30-day trial, then a paid license
points.text: StarUML is not open source; only the old V1 was. You can evaluate it free for 30 days, with a watermark on exported images, and then need to buy a license to keep using it.

points.title: Paid once per device
points.text: At the time of reading, Standard cost USD 159 per device and Professional USD 249 per device, before VAT, with lower prices from 10 devices and 30% off for students and teachers. There is no subscription and no floating license; you can move a license to a new device through the License Manager, and refunds are offered within 14 days.

points.title: Major versions cost extra
points.text: Updates within a major version are free, but a new major version needs a paid upgrade. A V7 license does not unlock V8, so check which version your key is for before you update.

points.title: What Professional adds
points.text: SysML, BPMN, UI wireframes and AWS, Google Cloud and Azure architecture diagrams are Professional only, as is code support for Ruby, Go, Kotlin, Rust, Dart and Swift. Standard covers UML, ERD, flowcharts, data flow, mind maps, C4, Mermaid and Java, C/C++, C#, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP and SQL DDL.

points.title: This listing trails the current release
points.text: StarUML 8, rewritten in Rust, was current at the time of reading, while this listing has 7.0.0 for Windows and 6.3.4 for Mac. Buyers can download earlier versions from the License Manager after signing in.

points.title: System requirements
points.text: For the current release, StarUML asks for Windows 10, macOS 14 or Ubuntu 24.04 or Fedora 43 and later. The Windows installer here is x64 and installs machine-wide; the Mac has separate Intel and Apple silicon disk images. The .deb and .rpm Linux builds are not part of this listing.

points.title: Old versions on Windows only
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 7 versions. macOS lists a single version.
